term: exists (quantifier over individuals in the modal embeddings)
resolution: Scott's variant (AFP GoedelGod.thy) quantifies over individuals possibilistically: ∃ ranges over the whole type at every world, so 'a God-like being exists' (T3, C2) means only that some individual is God-like there (DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY). Gödel's 1970 variant (AFP GoedelVariantHOML1.thy) uses the actualist ❙∃⇧E, relative to the existence predicate existsAt (DEF-HOML-ACTUALIST-NECESSITY), in Ax4, NecExist, Th2 and Th3. The Lean statements write the actualist quantifier as ∃ y, ex y v ∧ …, so the two senses are different formulas, and no result passes from one to the other. Property quantifiers are possibilist in both.
